ours.odd_even: z=abs(weighted odd depth-weighted even depth)/hypot(errors); BIC gain=z^2-ln(N), conflict when gain>10; N is sum of local sample counts. Event errors include local excess scatter and duration-bin beta inflation.
ours.secondary: Half-phase weighted event depths; sigma>=7 AND depth/primary>0.5. Eccentric secondary phases untested by this gate.

reference.odd_even: Formal BLS plus robust median depth with transit-timescale red noise; both discrepancies>3 sigma. Robust measurement requires3events and10in-transit cadences per parity; unavailable robust measurement uses BLS>10 sigma.
